The '''Amyrlin's Study''' is the location in the [[White Tower]] where the [[Amyrlin Seat]] conducts most of her business, save for ceremonial events and addresses to the Tower. The study is connected directly to the Amyrlin's personal chambers.

The Study has a tall golden marble fireplace from [[Kandor]], gilded stand lamps, a polished redstone floor from the [[Mountains of Mist]], pale striped wooden panels carved with marvelous beasts and birds, and tall gleaming pearly stone arched windows made of stone salvaged from a [[Ancient Structures|submerged city]]{{ref/book|6|7}}

The Anteroom of the Study is an empty room with the [[Keeper of the Chronicles]]'s writing desk and a row of chairs against the wall where Aes Sedai wait to speak to the Amyrlin, and tall outer doors.{{ref/book|6|7}}

The study bears remnants left behind from many past Amyrlin Seats. However, when [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] seized the position, she drastically overhauled the room, adding personal and controversial decor. Elaida added a thronelike chair with an ivory Flame of Tar Valon on the back and a massive writing table carved ornately in triple-linked rings with boxes of Altaran lacquerwork sitting on it. One box was worked in fighting golden hawks in a blue sky with white clouds. Elaida also added a white vase on a white plinth holding roses grown with the [[One Power]], and a painting depicting [[Rand al'Thor]]'s duel with [[Ishamael|Ba'alzamon]] at [[Falme]] above the fireplace.{{ref/book|6|7}}
